Class SceneBuilder

java.lang.Object
parser.SceneBuilder
public class SceneBuilder extends Object
Builds a Scene domain object from a generic parsed tree (the Map/List structure produced by JsonParser).

Single Responsibility: generic tree → domain objects. This class knows about Scene, geometries, lights and materials, but it knows nothing about JSON text syntax — that is the job of JsonParser. This separation satisfies SRP and keeps the parser reusable for other formats (e.g. a future XML reader could feed the same builder).

Supported scene structure

{
  "scene": {
    "background-color": "r g b",
    "ambient-light": { "color": "r g b" },
    "geometries": [ { "type": "...", ... }, ... ],
    "lights":     [ { "type": "...", ... }, ... ]
  }
}

Coordinates and colors are written as space-separated triples (e.g. "0 0 -100") to mirror the XML attribute convention. Both background, ambient, geometries and lights are optional, so the same builder serves a bare Stage-5 scene and a fully-lit later-stage scene.
